text:
ご返信ありがとうございます。 

 2年契約での支払いの件ですが、 

 2年目の支払いをしないのは契約違反ということは重々承知しております。

 2026/02/10 20:15、Steffan Jones <steffan@encord.com>のメール: 

 ﻿ 

 Dear Hayashi-san,  

 See my answers below: 

• 

T&Cs - You can view our terms and conditions here. The order form will reference these. The contract period is two years, but the payment is for one year? Payments are made annually 

• 

In this case, what happens if I don't pay for the second year? Then you will be in breach of contract - signing the two years is a commitment to paying for two years

• 

Or do I pay for two years in one lump sum? There can be an option to pay a lump sum if that is preferable 

• 

By what date must I pay this annual fee after placing my order? 30 days from invoice (you will be first invoiced upon signature of the contract)

• 

What payment methods are available? We accept card payments through Stripe and also bank transfers

• 

If the number of users increases during this contract period, could you please tell me the cost and payment schedule? There are two options. 1. There will be a $1,500 per user per year increase if the increase happens ad hoc, however 2. bulk discounts are also available upon requests. When agreed, we will send an order form to cover this increase in users, which will be invoiced upon signature. 

Best, 

Steffan

subject: Accepted: Encord <> Helsing | Catch-up
Re: Encord & Deepgram
text:
Hey, team!

Thanks for your patience here. Our legal team has reviewed the
contract/order form and has provided the following red lines in
the document and the following commentary. The contract itself needs to go
through a process with our finance and accounting team as well -- that's
been kicked off, and I'll loop back as soon as we have a timeline.
Apologies on the prolonged time frame (red tape is always a downer!)

Thank you for the agreement. We've made our redlines in the attached and
wanted to share a quick summary to keep things moving:

   1. Business Expectations. You'll see a few edits to clarify our business
      expectations -- that the license should cover use of the software for
      models that are commercially deployed (not just internal), and that any
      data we use with the software won’t be used by Encord for training or
      similar purposes.
      2. On deployment – just to confirm, we’ll be hosting the software in
      a VPC with strict client external integration controls. We
understand that
      means Encord won’t have access to our environment, and there’s no data
      transmission, storage, or other processing by Encord -- can you confirm
      that matches your understanding? If you have standard language you
      typically include for this setup, happy to review and include. Given this
      setup, we don’t believe Encord would be a processor under data protection
      laws, but we'd still like to implement a DPA and BAA on a “to the extent
      necessary” basis as a good measure.
      3. We also made some adjustments to the liability, indemnity, and
      termination-effect provisions to bring them closer to market and strike a
      fairer balance on both sides.
